summary: Frontend-only testing of the 3-page linkage + listing sub-nav dropdowns + detail-page shared branding. All 8 requested checks pass. No console errors on any of the three routes.

detailed_results.desktop_1920_hamburger_hidden: PASS - mobile-menu-toggle exists but is not visible (lg:hidden works)
detailed_results.mobile_390_hamburger_visible_and_opens_m: PASS - toggle visible, clicking opens mobile menu (Destinations/Trip types/Activities/Deals/About us/Login shown)
detailed_results.hero_search_egypt_suggestion_navigates: PASS - focusing hero-search-input shows hero-search-suggestions; hero-search-suggestion-egypt exists and clicking navigates to /afrika/aegypten
detailed_results.listing_subnav_dropdowns: PASS - eg-tabs present; eg-tab-1 opens dropdown with 3 items (Reiseführer), eg-tab-2 with 5 (Inspiration), eg-tab-3 with 6 (Orte). Outside click closes all dropdowns.
detailed_results.listing_to_luxor_detail: PASS - anchor a[href='/afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub'] present on listing; clicking (force) navigates to detail; egypt-detail-page renders. Note: there are 2 matching anchors on the listing (first has 0x0 box, likely a wrapping/hidden anchor around card badge) - not a bug, but see code review.
detailed_results.detail_breadcrumb_aegypten_link: PASS - breadcrumb Ägypten <a> has href='/afrika/aegypten' (visible in breadcrumb <ol> inside EgyptDetail)
detailed_results.detail_header_logo_home: PASS - header a[href='/'] (Hi Tours logo) navigates to /
detailed_results.detail_shared_branding: PASS - detail page renders shared <header> and <footer> (Hi Tours Header/Footer), sub-nav tabs (Ägypten Rundreisen / Reiseführer / Inspiration / Orte) visible at top with Kostenlos Planen CTA

critical_code_review_comments: Two <a href='/afrika/aegypten/luxor-strand-urlaub'> nodes exist for the Luxor card on the listing page; the first has 0x0 bounding box. Consider removing the duplicate wrapper anchor to avoid nested/duplicate links (a11y and SEO) and to make Playwright/CI clicks stable without force=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 routes wired: home hero search->Egypt listing, listing sub-nav dropdowns (Reiseführer 3 / Inspiration 5 / Orte 6, items link to '#' by design), listing card->detail, detail Header logo->home and breadcrumb Ägypten->listing. Shared Header/Footer used on detail. Test at 1920x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile.
